text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are women, meaning sex was not a deciding factor in selecting her over you. An all-female panel in healthcare is normal and does not indicate bias or impropriety. 

The decision clearly hinged on qualifications rather than gender: the hospital prioritized management coursework and broad leadership experience over your academic research credentials (PhD), which is common for department head roles. 

Bringing up the panel’s gender would lack factual or legal merit and could seriously damage your professional reputation. Instead, send a polite follow-up inquiring about constructive feedback to understand how you can strengthen your administrative and leadership profile for future executive positions.
